translation.name: Xchiʼdxyi cuubi dxiohs nin bieʼgaluuʼyi daada Jesucristu (El Nuevo Testamento en el zapoteco de Chichicapan y en español)

content: Pahblu hasta guihdxyi Efesu

Ya gaduhbi nin guyuuꞌ Apolos guihdxyi Corintu, gunaꞌzu nehza Pahblu para guihdxyi raꞌ xteenn Cilicia, Galacia, cun Frigia, ya chiꞌchiyi badzihn ba hasta guihdxyi Efesu. Riꞌchi badxaꞌga Pahblu nuhn bwiinn raꞌ nin gwachii stoꞌ raꞌñiꞌh xchiꞌdxyi Jesucristu,

chiꞌchi rahbi Pahblu loh raꞌ ba: ―¿Ta guyuuꞌtii Spíritu Saantu Dxiohs laꞌn lastoꞌ tu chin gwachii stoꞌ tu xchiꞌdxyi Jesucristu? Chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh Pahblu: ―Nin ayi gaann nu nuu Spíritu Saantu Dxiohs.
Chiꞌchi rahbi ba loh raꞌ ba: ―¿Xa gurohbaañihsa chiꞌh tu pwihsi? Chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh Pahblu: ―Gurohbaañihsa nu ziga baroꞌbañihsa Jwahn.

Chiꞌchi rahbi Pahblu loh raꞌ ba: ―Guchiica baroꞌbaañihsa Jwahn laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn chin gwachii stoꞌ raꞌ ba xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs, per rahbi za Jwahn loh raꞌ bwiinn: “Chechii stoꞌ tu xchiꞌdxyi bwiinn nin dxiꞌ diꞌtsihn.” Bwiinn nin bazeꞌta ba naa Jesucristu ―rahbi Pahblu.
Ya chin bihn raꞌ ba dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin guñiꞌ Pahblu lwehgu gahca gurohbañihsa raꞌ ba cun lah Jesucristu,

ya chiꞌchi badziiꞌba naa Pahblu yihca raꞌ ba tin guyuuꞌtiiꞌ Spíritu Saantu Dxiohs lastoꞌ raꞌ ba, ya chiꞌchi guzohbaloh cañiꞌ raꞌ ba guriin-guriin dxyiꞌzah cun neezaa dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ nin badiꞌhi Dxiohs guiñiꞌ raꞌ ba.
Ziga tsiꞌh bichiohpa naa raꞌ ndxiꞌhw nin guzahca ziꞌchi.

Zigachiꞌh chohnna bweꞌhw guillii-guillii baluuꞌyi Pahblu xchiꞌdxyi xcweenta xquelrnabwaꞌ Jesucristu loh raꞌ bwiinn laꞌn xquidoꞌ raꞌ bwiinn Israel, ya cun ayi bidxyihbi ba baluuꞌyi ba xcweenta xneziuh zaꞌca Dxiohs.

Per guyuuꞌ raꞌ nin guhca nahda duxa, ayi gwachii stoꞌ raꞌ ba xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs, mahziru guñiꞌ tohnta raꞌ ba xchiꞌdxyi Jesucristu loh raꞌ bwiinn, ya cun zenee Pahblu laꞌhsi raꞌ bwiinn nin gwachii stoꞌ raꞌñiꞌh xchiꞌdxyi Jesucristu rwaaꞌ tuhbi yuuꞌ scwehyi xteenn tuhbi nin bireꞌhlah Tiranu, ya riꞌchi baluuꞌyi Pahblu xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs laꞌh raꞌ ba garaatiiꞌ dxyih.
Ziꞌchi bwiꞌhnn Pahblu chiohpa yihza, niꞌchin garaa raꞌ bwiinn nin nuu raꞌ Asia ziga mohda bihn raꞌ ba xchiꞌdxyi Jesucristu, bwiinn Israel raꞌ cun neezaa nin ayi naa raꞌ bwiinn Israel.
Ya cun xquel rnabwaꞌ Dxiohs bwiꞌhnn Pahblu milahgru roo raꞌ.

Niꞌchin hasta baxchihn raꞌ ba cun tuhbi taaꞌga raꞌ lahdxi guxuhbi raꞌ ba hasta guzuu Pahblu tin cun lahdxi raꞌ chi gwanee raꞌ ban hasta rahcalluꞌhu bwiinn guxuhbi raꞌ ban laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn ya ziꞌchiꞌhzi biaaca raꞌ bwiinn cun neezaa spíritu dxaaba raꞌ bareꞌh raꞌ tihxi raꞌ bwiinn.

Ya guyuuꞌ paaldaa ndxiꞌhw raꞌ nin naa bwiinn Israel raꞌ nin gucaꞌnzaa ziahan guihdxyi raꞌ rbweꞌhe raꞌ ba bwiinndxaaba lastoꞌ raꞌ bwiinn. Ya bwiꞌhnn raꞌ ndxiꞌhw raꞌ riiꞌ lligaaba cweꞌhe raꞌ ba bwiinndxaaba lastoꞌ raꞌ bwiinn cun lah Jesucristu, chiꞌchi rahbi raꞌ ba loh tuhbi nin nuu bwiinndxaaba lastoꞌ ñiꞌh: ―Xcweenta xquelrnabwaꞌ Jesucristu nin ruluuꞌyi Pahblu xchiꞌdxyi Ñiꞌh, ¡bariaꞌh stoꞌ bwiinn ca! ―rahbi raꞌ ndxiꞌhw raꞌ chi.
Squiiꞌ bwiꞌhnn raꞌ gagahdzi lliiꞌn tuhbi bwiinn Israel nin laa Esceva, rnabwaꞌ ba laꞌh raꞌ bixohza.
Chiꞌchi rahbi bwiinndxaaba chi: ―Nuꞌnbwaꞌn Jesucristu, nee nuꞌnbwaꞌzahn Pahblu, ¿ya laꞌhtu chyu naa tu?, ayi nuꞌnbwaꞌn laꞌhtu.

Chiꞌchi billaꞌta ndxiꞌhw nin nuu bwiinndxaaba chi stoꞌ ñiꞌh yihca raꞌ lliiꞌn Esceva, ya puur goolpi duxa badiꞌhi ndxiꞌhw nin nuu bwiinndxaaba chi stoꞌ ñiꞌh laꞌh raꞌ lliiꞌn Esceva, ya cun tantu goolpi balluꞌn raꞌ gagahdzi ndxiꞌhw raꞌ chi cun biuhyiza xahba raꞌ ba llihgabweꞌhlaraꞌsi ndxiꞌhw raꞌ chi bwaa raꞌ bi rwaaꞌ yihdzi raꞌ bi cun neezaa bidxeeldxyihdxyi duxa tihxi raꞌ bi.

Ya garaa raꞌ nin guyuuꞌ raꞌ guihdxyi Efesu, bwiinn Israel raꞌ cun neezaa nin ayi naa raꞌ bwiinn Israel raꞌ, bihn raꞌ ba nin guzahca raꞌ ndxiꞌhw raꞌ chi, ya bidxyihbi duxa raꞌ bwiinn raꞌ chi ya guñiꞌ zaꞌca raꞌ ba xcweenta lah Jesucristu.
Ya ziahan roo raꞌ nin gwachii stoꞌ raꞌñiꞌh xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs gudxihxteeꞌ raꞌ ba garaa raꞌ cohsa dxaaba raꞌ nin bwiꞌhnn raꞌ ba.

Cun ziahan raꞌ za nin basiꞌdxi dxihtsi xteenn guelbidxaꞌha gwanee raꞌ ba dxihtsi raꞌ chi tin bacaꞌdxih raꞌ ban delanta loh raꞌ bwiinn ziahan. Ya seguihdu bwiꞌhnn raꞌ ba cweenta balaaca mweeyi lasahca raꞌ dxihtsi raꞌ chi; chwaꞌhabitsiꞌh mihyi mweeyi de plata lasahcan.
Ya ziꞌchizi bidiꞌchii xchiꞌdxyi Jesucristu ziahan lahta ya laꞌhan mahziru guhcaguiyaaꞌhan loh garaatiiꞌ raꞌ cuunchiꞌhzi dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ.

Ya chin guluhlla raꞌ cohsa raꞌ riiꞌ, guluuꞌtii Spíritu Saantu lligaaba yihca Pahblu chee ba garaa raꞌ guihdxyi nin rnabwaꞌ guihdxyi Macedonia cun guihdxyi Acaya, ya chiꞌchiyi chee gah ba hasta guihdxyi Jerusalehn. Ya cun neezaa bwiꞌhnn ba lligaaba: “Yaque laꞌnguyaaꞌha guihdxyi Jerusalehn neezaa para Roma guzaaꞌhahn.”
Ya chiꞌchi guxeꞌhla Pahblu chiohpa ayudante ba nin laa raꞌ Timoteu cun Erastu para guihdxyi Macedonia, ya laꞌh Pahblu biaꞌhan ba guihdxyi Asia spaaldaa yihza.
Bidxyiꞌchi duxa raꞌ bwiinn Efesu
Laꞌn yihza chi, guyuuꞌ duxa raꞌ bwiinn Efesu guelrzaaꞌ laasii baluuꞌyi Pahblu xchiꞌdxyi Dxiohs nin nuu dxibaaꞌ.

Deeꞌ bwiꞌhnn tuhbi plateru nin laa Demetriu. Ndxiꞌhw riiꞌ ruhnnchaꞌyi bwiinn gulaala cun dxiꞌba plata, ya dee raꞌ naa xchaan raꞌ ba laꞌn guidoꞌ xteenn tuhbi dxaan nin laa Diana, ya laꞌh dxaan riiꞌ raann raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi Efesu, ya rudiꞌhi dziꞌn riiꞌ ziahan mweeyi laꞌh raꞌ xmooza ba nin rahcanee rahcachaꞌyi raꞌ dxaan dxiꞌba plahta raꞌ chi.

Ya seguihdu batiaaꞌha Demetriu garaa raꞌ xmooza ba cun snuhn raꞌ bwiinn nin ruhnn dziꞌn ziga nin ruhnn ba, chiꞌchi rahbi ba loh raꞌ ba: ―Daada raꞌ, laꞌhtu naann tu dziꞌn raꞌ in riidiꞌhnn nuꞌh laꞌhan ruhnn mantanehra laꞌh raꞌnuꞌh.

Laꞌtu ba bwaꞌha cun neezaa bihn tu xa cagaluuꞌyi Pahblu laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn, rahbi ba: “Ayi Dxiohs dxiꞌh naa raꞌ nin rahcachaꞌyi cun naa raꞌ bwiinn”, ya ziꞌchi cagaluuꞌyi Pahblu laꞌh raꞌ bwiinn, yannah cun ayiru cayuhnn cweenta raꞌ ba nin riidiꞌhnnchaꞌyi nuꞌh. Ayi nnastoꞌdxiꞌh tu guihdxyi Efesu si sino que garaa raꞌ guihdxyi nin rnabwaꞌ Asia.

Ya deeꞌ mahla duxan para laꞌhnuꞌh laasii ayiru gacalasahca raꞌ xtsiꞌn raꞌ nuꞌh cun neezaa xquidoꞌXchiohs nuꞌh nin laa Diana, neezaa guelraann duxa raꞌ bwiinn laꞌh Diana ziñihchilohon, ya ziꞌchi cun ayiru chyu guunncweenta laꞌh Dxiohs riiꞌ nee Dxiohs dxiꞌh rii raann raꞌ garaatiiꞌ raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ Asia cun garaa raꞌ bwiinn guidxyiyuh.
Chin bihn raꞌ ba garaa nin guñiꞌ Demetriu loh raꞌ ba bidxyiꞌchi duxa raꞌ ba rahbi raꞌ ba: ―¡Lasahca duxa Diana Xchiohs raꞌ bwiinn guihdxyi Efesu!

Ya bwiinn guihdxyi Efesu raꞌ chi, chiꞌchi gunaꞌzu raꞌ ba laꞌh Gahyu cun Aristarcu chiohpa bwiinn Macedonia nin caꞌnzanee Pahblu, ya garoopa raꞌ ba gulluꞌbiyuh raꞌ ba hasta laꞌn jusgadu, hasta rahca rrehgla xcweenta xchixiꞌhw raꞌ ba.
Guclaaꞌdzi Pahblu ñuuꞌtii ba tin guiñiꞌ ba loh raꞌ bwiinn, per ayi basaaꞌn raꞌ xpwiinn Jesucristu nin rii riꞌchi laꞌh Pahblu.
Cun paaldaa raꞌ guxchiisi raꞌ nin rnabwaꞌ raꞌ Asia xamihgu raꞌ ba laꞌh Pahblu niꞌchin ayiza gunnah raꞌ ba ñuuꞌtii Pahblu lahdaa raꞌ bwiinn chi.
Ya loh juunta chi guriin-guriin rñiꞌ raꞌ bwiinn raꞌ chi; tuhbi riidxaaꞌ duxa nin cayahca riꞌchi ya ziahan raꞌza bwiinn raꞌ chi nin ayi gaann raꞌ ba xi badxaꞌga lasaaꞌ raꞌ ba riꞌchi.

Ya nuu raꞌ bwiinn Israel nin gudxixteeꞌ loh tuhbi daada nin laa Alejandru xa naa raꞌ asuntu chi, chiꞌchi bacaꞌnaa raꞌ ba laꞌh Alejandru nez delanta loh raꞌ ba tin guiñiꞌ ba xcweenta bwiinn Israel raꞌ, chiꞌchi bazaꞌbi ba naa ba loh raꞌ bwiinn tin gucaꞌdxiahga raꞌ ba nin ñiñiꞌ ba pur laꞌh bwiinn Israel loh raꞌ bwiinn ziahan raꞌ chi,
per chin guhcabwaꞌ raꞌ bwiinn Efesu raꞌ chi naa Alejandru tuhbi bwiinn Israel, ya mas chiohpa hohra gudidxyidxiahyoꞌba raꞌ ba, rahbi raꞌ ba: ―¡Lasahca duxa Diana Xchiohs raꞌ bwiinn Efesu!

Chiꞌchi guñiꞌ secretariu xteenn guihdxyi Efesu chi, ya lwehgu gunabwaꞌ ba biahcadxyii raꞌ bwiinn, chiꞌchi rahbi ba: ―Gulgacaꞌdxiahga bwiinn Efesu raꞌ, gaduhbi guidxyiyuh bwiinn naann raꞌ ba Efesu nahpaa chaꞌyi laꞌh Diana Xchiohs nuꞌh nin lasahca duxa dxaan nin zeꞌ loh planeta nin laa Júpiter,
niꞌchin ayi chyu nin guiñiꞌ ayi guchii dxiꞌh deeꞌ, nnah gulgasaguuꞌdzi lastoꞌ tu,
laasii laꞌh raꞌ ndxiꞌhw raꞌ rii ¿xi pura gunaꞌzu tu laꞌh raꞌ ba? Ayi xi gubaꞌn ruhnn raꞌ ba, ayiza rñiꞌyah raꞌ ba laꞌh Xchiohs raꞌnuꞌh.
Yannah sidela xclaaꞌdzi Demetriu cun garaa ziga gunaꞌzu raꞌ ba ndxiꞌhw raꞌ riꞌ dxieꞌtachi raꞌ ba guelchiah, zohballaala jusgadu tin dxieꞌgañiꞌ raꞌ ba bweelaa nuu xi llahn nuu tu,
ya sidela nuu xi stuhbi juunta xclaaꞌdzi tu, chiꞌchi gacan tuhbi juunta nin guchii,

laasii ya cagalluꞌn tuhbi peligro para laꞌhnuꞌh laasii rlluꞌn rriezgu gahbi raꞌ ba badiaaꞌha nuꞌh tin guidxihldxinee nuꞌh gubieerna pur nin guhca nnadxyih, ya cun ayi xi guidiꞌtsii nuꞌh xcweenta nin badxaꞌga lasaaꞌ nuꞌh nnadxyih. Chin guyaꞌloh guñiꞌ secretariu chi garaa dxyiꞌdxyi raꞌ riiꞌ, chiꞌchi rahbi ba:
―Banaa guldxiuuꞌ nehza. Ya biuuꞌnehza raꞌ bwiinn chi para yihdzi raꞌ ba.
